newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN FGEP GROUP TO TENDER FOR 216,000T U.S. CORN.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN FGEP GROUP TO TENDER FOR 216,000T U.S. CORN.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender on Friday for four 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. No.2 corn, traders said on Thursday.
The 216,000-tonne tender is unprecedented for FGEP group -- Taiwan's largest corn buying interest, traders said.
"This is the first time that the FGEP group is seeking for four shipments in one tender," a Taipei-based U.S. trader said. "The group normally buys one shipment per month."
Traders said the FGEP group's unusually large tender is a reflection on its buyers' bullish view on the Chicago market.
"The group's buyers must believe the corn futures will continue a bull run for a while," another trader said.
A buyer at the group cautioned, however, the Friday's tender might just be its strategy to test the market's prices without intention of buying all four shipments.
"Tomorrow will be a great chance to test the December and January corn outlook," he said, adding the group may just buy two shipments and pass on the other two.
The FGEP group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprise, President Enterprise, Ever Smile Feed Mill Co and Fong Yu.
